newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares close mixed on low volumes.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares close mixed on low volumes.

text.p: Russian shares closed mixed on Friday as Mosnenergo fell on news of low preliminary 1996 profits and Irkutskenergo rose on the beginning of trade in its American Depositary Receipts in Germany, traders said.
The Russian Trading System index of 24 shares fell by 0.29 percent to 274.68 on $23.04 million in volume.
Mosenergo fell to $1.46 from $1.50 at Thursday's close. Irkutskenergo rose to $0.280 from $0.259.

"The market is in a state of equilibrium and volumes are minimal," said Dmitry Starenko, chief trader at Regent European Securities. "After a month and a half of crazy growth both investors and brokers are falling off their feet with fatigue."
Traders said they expected the market to be slow into Monday.
Starenko said Western investors sold Mosenergo following the company's preliminary results, though other traders said Russians had been the primary sellers.
Mosenergo's CEO said he expected 1997 net profit to drop to 1.5 trillion roubles from 2.8 trillion roubles in 1996.
Oleg Martynenko, head of share department at Bank Menatep, said despite the news there was still interest in Mosenergo.
Martynenko said he expected prices to rise slightly next week as banks entered the equity market.
"It is now unprofitable for banks to hold their positions in cash and they are feverishly looking where to invest," he said.
Banks primarily will buy leading shares such as Surgutneftegaz, LUKoil and Mosenergo, which they still consider cheap, he said.
LUKoil slipped to $14.27 from $14.35, Surgutneftegaz rose to $0.586 from $0.581 and UES rose to $0.1550 after $0.1530.
